title: Account Treatment While a Plan Runs: Fees, Reporting, Collections and AutoPay (Hardship Assistance Programs)
content:
How the loan is treated while a plan of the Hardship Assistance Programs is in place differs by program. The matrix below states, per program, the fee, reporting, collection and AutoPay treatment and the plan payment grace figures.

## Fees and payment grace

| Program | Late fees suspended during the plan | Fee waiver look-back (calendar days) | Plan payment grace (calendar days) | Missed plan installments that break the plan |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Short-Term Payment Deferral | yes | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| Reduced Payment Plan | yes | 30 | 10 | 1 |
| Temporary Rate Reduction Plan | yes | 30 | 10 | 1 |
| Term Extension Modification | yes | 60 | 10 | 1 |
| Disaster Relief Deferral | yes | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| Servicemember Rate Cap Benefit | yes | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| Charged-Off Settlement Plan | no | 0 | 10 | 1 |

- **Late fees suspended**: whether late fees are suspended on installments falling due while the plan is active.
- **Fee waiver look-back**: late and returned-payment fees assessed within this many calendar days before the request date are waived when the plan becomes active.
- **Plan payment grace**: calendar days after a plan installment due date before an unpaid plan installment breaks the plan; 0 when there are no plan installments.
- **Missed plan installments that break the plan**: plan installments unpaid past the plan grace period that break the plan; 0 when there are no plan installments.

## Reporting, collections and AutoPay

| Program | Credit bureau reporting during the plan | Collection calls and letters stop | AutoPay discount keeps applying |
|---|---|---|---|
| Short-Term Payment Deferral | reported with the status it had at the request date; deferred installments are not reported as missed | yes | yes |
| Reduced Payment Plan | reported as paying under a partial payment agreement | yes | yes |
| Temporary Rate Reduction Plan | reported as paying under a partial payment agreement | yes | no |
| Term Extension Modification | reported current during trial; reported as modified on completion | yes | yes |
| Disaster Relief Deferral | reported with the status it had at the request date and the natural-disaster comment | yes | yes |
| Servicemember Rate Cap Benefit | reported current; no hardship comment | yes | no |
| Charged-Off Settlement Plan | reported as settled for less than the full balance on completion | no | no |

- **AutoPay discount keeps applying**: whether an AutoPay discount keeps applying while the plan is active (plans that set their own rate replace it).

## Hypothetical illustration

A late fee assessed 45 calendar days before the request date falls inside the 60-day look-back of the Term Extension Modification and outside the 30-day look-back of the Reduced Payment Plan.
